qwen_base/BASE11_agentic_grep_25c00b67.query_text: Which deposits have more than 50 million in extracted crude total?

PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?deposit (SUM(?extractedCrude) AS ?totalExtractedCrude)
WHERE {
  ?output eno:outputForDeposit ?deposit .
  ?output eno:extractedCrude ?extractedCrude .
}
GROUP BY ?deposit
HAVING (SUM(?extractedCrude) > 50)

SELECT ?operator ?deposit

  FILTER (!BOUND(?toDate) || ?toDate >= "2024-01-01"^^xsd:date) .

}

PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>

SELECT ?operator ?depositDesignation ?registryId
WHERE {
  ?deposit a eno:Deposit .
  ?deposit eno:activeDepositOperator ?operator .
  ?deposit eno:designation ?depositDesignation .
  ?deposit eno:registryId ?registryId .
}
ORDER BY ?operator

qwen_base/BASE20_agentic_semantic_0612e3.query_text: For each active deposit operator, list all the deposits they operate.
qwen_base/BASE20_agentic_semantic_0612e3.final_sparql:
PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>

SELECT ?operator ?depositDesignation ?registryId
WHERE {
  ?operator a eno:DepositOperator .
  ?operator eno:dateDepositOperatorFrom ?fromDate .
  OPTIONAL { ?operator eno:dateDepositOperatorTo ?toDate } .
  FILTER (!BOUND(?toDate) || ?toDate >= "2024-01-01"^^xsd:date) .
  ?operator eno:operatorForDeposit ?deposit .
  ?deposit eno:designation ?depositDesignation .
  ?deposit eno:registryId ?registryId .
}

qwen_base/BASE01_agentic_grep_3f32cf2a.query_text: Show me 5000 examples of learners enrolled in courses instructed by educators employed at their own division.
qwen_base/BASE01_agentic_grep_3f32cf2a.final_sparql:
PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?learner ?course ?educator ?division
WHERE {
  ?learner a eduo:Learner .
  ?learner eduo:enrolledIn ?course .
  ?course a eduo:Course .
  ?educator eduo:instructorOf ?course .
  ?educator a eduo:Educator .
  ?educator eduo:employedAt ?division .
  ?division a eduo:Division .
}
LIMIT 5000

qwen_base/BASE03_agentic_semantic_a66a6e.query_text: List activities with their input and output flows.
qwen_base/BASE03_agentic_semantic_a66a6e.final_sparql:
PREFIX oriont: <https://orienting.eu/oriont#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?activity ?activityLabel ?flowType ?flowLabel
WHERE {
  ?activity a oriont:Activity .
  ?activity rdfs:label ?activityLabel .
  
  { ?inputFlow oriont:isInputOf ?activity .
    ?inputFlow rdfs:label ?flowLabel .
    BIND("Input" AS ?flowType)
  }
  UNION
  { ?outputFlow oriont:isOutputOf ?activity .
    ?outputFlow rdfs:label ?flowLabel .
    BIND("Output" AS ?flowType)
  }
}
LIMIT 20

PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?division (COUNT(?person) AS ?personCount) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?courseLabel; separator=", ") AS ?courses)
WHERE {
  ?person eduo:belongsTo ?division .
  ?person eduo:enrolledIn ?course .
  ?course eduo:label ?courseLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?division
ORDER BY DESC(?personCount)

qwen_syn/SYN08_agentic_grep_0227d4c2.final_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?station ?name (COUNT(?event) AS ?tripCount)
WHERE {
    ?event a tro:StopEvent .
    ?event tro:station ?station .
    ?station foaf:name ?name .
}
GROUP BY ?station ?name

qwen_syn/SYN09_agentic_grep_469bd876.final_sparql:
PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?faculty ?label
WHERE {
  ?faculty a eduo:Faculty .
  ?faculty eduo:label ?label .
  
  # Faculty teaches at least one upper-level class (AdvancedModule)
  ?faculty eduo:instructorOf ?course .
  ?course a eduo:AdvancedModule .
  
  # Faculty has no supervisees (using NOT EXISTS)
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?faculty eduo:supervises ?supervisee .
  }
}

qwen_syn/SYN21_agentic_semantic_5035111a.final_sparql:
PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?companyName ?permit ?condition
WHERE {
  ?licensee eno:licenceLicensee ?company .
  ?company eno:designation ?companyName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?companyName, "Aker"))
  ?licensee eno:licenseeForLicence ?permit .
  ?permit eno:currentCondition ?condition .
}
ORDER BY ?companyName ?permit

qwen_typo/TYPO01_agentic_grep_0bee7b77.query_text: Show me 5000 exampels of learnres enrolld in coureses instructd by educatros employd at their own divison.
qwen_typo/TYPO01_agentic_grep_0bee7b77.final_sparql:
PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>

SELECT ?learner ?course ?educator ?division
WHERE {
  ?learner eduo:belongsTo ?division .
  ?learner eduo:enrolledIn ?course .
  ?educator eduo:instructorOf ?course .
  ?educator eduo:employedAt ?division .
}
LIMIT 5000

qwen_typo/TYPO04_agentic_grep_09974aab.final_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?lineAbbrev ?stationName
WHERE {
  ?stopEvent a tro:StopEvent .
  ?stopEvent tro:station ?station .
  ?stopEvent tro:journey ?trip .
  ?trip tro:line ?line .
  ?line tro:abbreviation ?lineAbbrev .
  ?station foaf:name ?stationName .
